'''Bonadan booze''' was a kind of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that shared a name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Sysco]] kept a bottle of Bonadan booze in the bottom drawer of his desk in his living quarters that were aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|''Vengeance'']]. It was in the aftermath of the [[Mission to Dorlo]], after the death of [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] and his team, and [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] lead to the [[Valley of the Jedi]], when he decided it was time to break it open.<ref name="Rebel Agent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bonadan booze was created for and first appeared in the [[1998]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', which was written by [[William C. Dietz]].<ref name="Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
